name: 16273-repeatedimage-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03; see configs/env.yaml.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1 — one request in flight at a time, the same serial single-job shape the report was taken in; warmup 20%, bound 400 requests, 2400 s safety cap.
workload: Single-turn image+text: four 896x896 jpeg images per request, byte-identical within a request (four synthetic_image sources sharing seed 16273) and different across requests, plus a 32-token instruction and a 16-token answer, both pinned min=max with ignore_eos.
purpose: A vision assistant answering one-at-a-time questions about four duplicate 896-pixel photos with brief replies on one GPU.
launch:
# Launch config: every key here is passed straight to AsyncEngineArgs at the pinned commit.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct

# The engine default is ONE image per modality per prompt, under which every four-image request in
# scenario.json is rejected before it reaches the engine.
# MUST STAY ON ONE LINE -- the engine's config reader is a flat line reader and skips indented
# lines, so a block mapping here drops the key and the engine starts without it at rc=0.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 4}

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# 4096 image tokens + a 32-token instruction + chat template + 16 generated: comfortably under 4.3k.
max-model-len: 8192
